members.name: Devarth Patel
members.title: President
members.bio: I am a rising four-year undergraduate student at Ohio State University pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Economics. Additionally, I am a Morrill Excellence Scholar and a Law & Society Scholar on the Pre-Law track. I am interested in developing a strong understanding of economic systems and financial policy to help create a more equitable and sustainable future for all.

members.name: Peter Chen
members.title: Vice President
members.bio: I am a second-year Economics major and Statistics minor at The Ohio State University with a strong interest in asset management, equity research, and financial markets. I am actively seeking internship opportunities in asset management, wealth management, and related areas of finance. I am passionate about growing my network with peers, mentors, and professionals in economics and finance.

members.name: Adam Niktash
members.title: Treasurer
members.bio: A self-motivated individual pursuing a Business Administration degree at the Fisher School of Business. I am looking to develop my existing skills further and attend the Moritz College of Law.

members.name: Henry Gillies
members.title: Secretary
members.bio: I am Henry Gillies, a first-year Honors Economics (BS) student at Ohio State with minors in History and Public Management. I am devoted to promoting and improving the economic growth of Columbus and beyond. I do so through employment and community involvement, where I am building transferable skills for the public sector, nonprofit field, and economic policy research. Please don’t hesitate to reach out!

members.name: Emiliy Max

members.name: Evan Menges
